title: Leveraging Robust Optimization for LLM Alignment under Distribution Shifts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance and alignment robustness on preference datasets (e.g., HH-RLHF, Summarization, UltraFeedback) under mixture response shifts, where the training data is augmented with synthetic LLM-generated responses that deviate from human-preferred target distributions. The evaluation also includes measuring robustness against artificial label noise (randomly flipping preference labels).
